notes: Account: late-stage fintech platform doing personalization + compliance-sensitive search

poc_results_summary: Throughput: steady-state validated at ~550 rps for short rerank requests with 6x GPUs under continuous load
Latency: p95 ~180ms at steady state, p99 spikes to 420ms during cold-starts without warm pool
Warm pool impact: pre-warmed nodes reduced cold-start p99 from 420ms to 120ms (90% reduction on test cases)
Autoscale: default cooldown (30s) led to thrashing under bursty traffic; 45-60s cooldown recommended
Queueing: unbounded queueing caused queue times to exceed 8s in synthetic bursts — prefer bounded queue + early reject or prioritized tails
Model fallback: automatic fallback to 13B variant keeps latency within targets but increases token-level error on some rerank cases
Network: VPC peering egress caps caused ~10% throughput degradation during large batch prep; needs infra tweak
desired_slos: Reranking: steady throughput >= 500 rps, p95 latency <= 200ms, p99 <= 350ms
Doc-search embedding: p95 <= 150ms for vector upsert and query pipelines
Availability: 99.95% monthly uptime target for dedicated pool (SLA credit required)
Queue wait time: median queue < 200ms, 99th < 2s for prioritized traffic
proposed_reserved_capacity: Initial commit: 8x A100-equivalent GPUs (region spread across 2 AZs)
Buffer plan: 2x GPU warm pool reserved per AZ to reduce cold starts
Burst capacity: allow surge to additional 4 GPUs for peak market hours on pre-approved billing
Auto-fallback: route excess to hosted API fallback with throttling and degraded SLA for non-critical routes
autoscaling_policy_summary: Scale-up trigger: add 1 GPU node when queue length > 40 for 30s or CPU/GPU busy > 85% for 20s
Scale-down trigger: remove 1 GPU node after 300s of node idle time, but maintain warm-pool floor (min 2 per AZ)
Cooldowns: recommended scale-up cooldown 60s, scale-down cooldown 300s to avoid oscillation
Batching: leverage continuous batching where applicable with max batch latency 50ms to trade throughput vs latency
Canary: canary 10% traffic to new model variant for 10 mins then ramp if metric delta <2%
queueing_and_warm_pool_requirements: Warm pool: maintain 2 hot nodes/GPUs per AZ for sub-second cold-start behavior
Queueing strategy: hybrid bounded queue with priority lanes (re-rank high priority, background indexing low priority)
Backpressure: apply early reject for non-priority requests when queue depth > 200 to protect SLOs
Observability: require token-level latency histograms, per-route queue depth alerts, and tracing for queued requests
SLA expectations: queue time SLOs and failover routing must be included in contract; credits tied to queue violations
